title: Not perfect
text: Not perfect. The rack would be perfect if it weren't for the rear stand holder.  The rear holder does not extend enough to steadily hold book on stand.  The rear holder is not adjustable which is a disadvantage.  You want a cook book to lean a bit back when reading a recipe, not stand straight up.  The stand itself is very sturdy and very attractive.
